theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V T : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn (n + ℓ)), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → (∀ u ∈ V, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ u)) → T ⊆ V → 0 < volume T → ∃ J : Finset (Fin (n + ℓ)), J.card = n ∧ 0 < μHE[n] (coordinateProjection J '' (ψ '' T))
